title: Microsoft Edge: opt-in for launching Edge when Windows starts on managed devices
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, user-choice default and both policy control routes are supported. All three Learn pages flagged by the pre-check were readable, and the updated Stable release notes still describe this feature as a controlled rollout.

claims.claim: Edge will offer users on managed devices an opt-in to launch automatically when Windows starts.
claims.quote: Microsoft Edge will introduce an opt-in experience that allows users on managed devices to choose whether Edge launches automatically when Windows starts.

claims.claim: Administrators can manage the behaviour through LaunchEdgeOnWindowsStartupEnabled with opt-in, opt-out and user-choice configurations.
claims.quote: Administrators can also manage this behavior through the LaunchEdgeOnWindowsStartupEnabled policy with opt-in, opt-out, and user-choice configurations.

claims.claim: The default is user-opt-in: without a configured policy, Edge does not automatically launch at Windows startup.
claims.quote: If you don't configure this policy, Microsoft Edge won't launch automatically when Windows starts by default. Users are periodically shown an opt-in banner to turn it on, and can enable or disable automatic launch anytime from settings.

claims.quote: Mandatory policies override user preferences and prevent the user from changing the policy settings.

claims.claim: The setting is in Group Policy Editor at Computer Configuration > Policies > Administrative Templates > Microsoft Edge > Launch Microsoft Edge on Windows startup; the cited policy page documents the final setting.
claims.quote:
GP name: Launch Microsoft Edge on Windows startup
To configure a mandatory policy, open the Group Policy Editor and go to (Computer Configuration or User Configuration) > Policies > Administrative Templates > Microsoft Edge.

claims.claim: The registry control is SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge, value LaunchEdgeOnWindowsStartupEnabled of type REG_DWORD, as documented at the cited URL.
claims.quote:
Path (Mandatory): SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge
Value name: LaunchEdgeOnWindowsStartupEnabled
Value type: REG\_DWORD
